name: Sparse Ray Marching with Nested Axis-Aligned Distance Fields (NAADF)
definition: A sparse ray marching technique using nested axis-aligned distance fields to skip over empty space. It replaces brick coordinate rasterization with a simpler pipeline suitable for gbuffer and path tracing.
summary: NAADF is a sparse ray marching technique that skips empty space in voxel grids by calculating the largest empty region along the ray's path via axis-aligned bounds, allowing it to step over multiple cells at once.
